children: On August 26, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq letter noting that following its 1-for-4 reverse split it had fewer than the 500,000 publicly held shares required under Listing Rule 5550(a)(4). Nasdaq determined the company complied as of August 21, 2026, and no further action is required. The stock continues trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under PFSA.
